    # Track testpaths as seen
    if stripped.startswith('testpaths ='):
        seen_keys.add('testpaths')
    
    # Skip empty lines at problematic places

        next_stripped = lines[i+1].strip() if i+1 < len(lines) else ''
        # Remove double blank lines in pytest section
        if prev_stripped == '' and next_stripped == '':
            continue
    
    new_lines.append(line)
